sections.changelog:
1.72.27

  • Encyclopedia intake stage-2 path: when an article arrives for an existing thin draft, the draft is filled and joins the publishing drip; published or scheduled entries are never overwritten.

1.72.26

  • Encyclopedia intake: the glossary engine now accepts full-world entries (terms, materials, tools, methods, roles, regulations, standards, people, organizations, publications, formulas, software) with the attached English term, and schedules them on a steady drip (default 12/day across working hours) instead of bulk publishing. Ontology-only rows wait as drafts until their article arrives. Term pages show the English term.

1.72.25

  • Self-healing catalog: rewrite rules re-flush automatically on every plugin version change (incident: /projects/ and /professionals/ 404ed after a deploy window).
  • The free first month is TRUE: the Pro plan auto-applies a one-per-customer 100% coupon so the first checkout is a genuine 0 with no card; month 2 is billed by the renewal engine at full price. Product name states the mechanics honestly.

1.72.24

  • Month-2 revenue machine: 3 days before a paid tier expires, a renewal order for the same product and card is created automatically and the customer receives the standard invoice email with a one-click pay link (Morning card / Bit / Google Pay). Payment extends the tier through the existing activation pipe; unpaid renewals stay payable for 7 grace days, then auto-cancel and the tier drops as before. Forward-compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions for fully automatic token charges.

1.72.23

  • Listing funnel de-frictioned: the wizard gate now opens an account in one step (name + email) and drops the visitor straight into the wizard - no email round-trip, no WordPress screens. Existing emails get a login link; rate-limited and bot-protected.
  • The advertisers page gained a native call-back form (name, phone, interest) feeding the lead system - developers who will not open WhatsApp still convert.
  • /pricing/ now goes to the commercial tiers page instead of slug-guessing onto an article.

1.72.22

  • B2B funnel first fixes: the premium catalog's developer CTA pointed at a dead /contact/ page - now goes to the live advertisers page.

1.72.21

  • The window view is a window, not a still: drag to look sideways, down toward the street and up toward the sky, at the apartment's real floor height.
  • Map, buyer edition: opens on the Tel Aviv-Jerusalem core by default and silently approximates to the visitor's area (IP level, no permission prompt); a 'Projects near me' button uses precise location only when asked; 3D terrain relief; premium projects fly a flag with the 3D model badge, one click to the full experience; the copy now talks to buyers, not about the map.
  • Language switcher, brand and 3D viewer are translate-proof (browser auto-translate was mangling tabs and badges).
  • The international buyers hub is linked from the homepage.

1.72.20

  • The live drone map now leads the front door: a designed showcase band (LIVE badge, serif title, 560px satellite stage with cluster bubbles) right under the flagship band on the homepage in all 5 languages, and under the premium catalog grid. It boots itself as you scroll to it - zero cost to first paint. The projects catalog keeps its collapsible version.
  • Map popups and cluster labels localized (he/en/fr/ru/ar).

1.72.19

  • The whole catalog is on the map: 954 newly geocoded projects (12 neighborhood-level, 942 city-level) join the drone map as honest CLUSTERS - a '197 projects' bubble on a city center instead of stacked pins pretending to be addresses; cluster click zooms in or lists the projects; city-level popups say so.
  • Honesty gate: apartments in projects with only city-level coordinates do not offer the per-window view (a specific view from a city centroid would be fiction); the area map still shows them.

1.72.18

  • RFP advisor matching unblocked for the demonstration phase (per owner) - the directory demo badges stay; the exclusion returns before the marketing push.
  • Buyers on Arabic pages now receive the English RFP document (Gulf and international buyers read English; a Hebrew document closed no circle).
  • Indexing: the word-floor noindex on professionals and properties is retired per owner directive - the directory enters the index as structured data-driven content. Demo profiles and junk facet combinations keep their guards.
  • Protected key-handoff endpoint POST /nadlan/v1/keys (admin app-password auth) so API keys can be pushed from the owner's machine without wp-admin, chat or repo exposure.

1.72.17

  • Est. monthly payment on every apartment panel (70% financing, 25 years, 5% - estimate only, clearly noted): the number every buyer computes anyway, now computed for them in all 5 languages.
  • Honesty guard: profiles carrying seeded demo ratings are excluded from RFP advisor matching - no fictional person can be named in a real buyer's document.
  • Premium default walk: featured projects switch to the premium-default-* sample set automatically once it is rich enough (4+ spaces), with its own honest label.

1.72.16

  • Apartment panel: the gray frame-in-frame scrollbar is gone - the panel scrolls invisibly with a soft bottom fade cue instead (buy-flow overlay too).
  • Dedicated walk per project: upload media titled walk-<project-slug>-<space> and the page walk switches from the standard set to the project's own pictures automatically (CMS hint added in the project editor). Projects whose apartments already have generated interiors (like Rainbow) walk through THOSE instead of the standard set, labeled per apartment.
  • Professionals (#34): ratings without verified reviews now carry an honest little 'sample data' badge on cards and profiles.

1.72.15

  • Default walk: 360-* uploads (equirectangular panoramas for the future 360 layer) are excluded from the flat walk - a 2:1 panorama would render warped as a room frame.

1.72.14

  • Default walk: building-exterior/building-entrance naming variants normalized so the walk always starts at the building and flows inward with correct labels in all languages. The full 12-space standard set is live: exterior, entrance, lobby, stairwell, elevator, entry hall, living room, kitchen, bedrooms, bathroom, balcony.

1.72.13

  • Default walk: the step transition now waits for the next space's image to fully load before revealing - on slow connections the old room can no longer appear under the new room's label.

1.72.12

  • The DEFAULT walk on every project page: the interior-tour section now carries a first-person step-through of the standard sample apartment and building (drag to look, arrows and door chips to move between spaces), fed automatically from the standard-default-* media set - new spaces join as they upload. Honestly labeled; a developer's dedicated tour replaces it per project the moment it arrives. No more 'tour pending' dead-ends.

1.72.11

  • The view tab IS the window now: an inline real-world viewport standing at the apartment's floor height, looking in its real compass direction - live satellite with 3D buildings, look-left/right controls, honest note. The buyer sees what is actually outside the window (a building? a school? the sea?) without visiting. Interior render moved to a secondary expandable; the live POI map stays one tap away.

1.72.10

  • Hotfix: an empty tour link no longer resolves to the homepage (the browser URL parser turned "" into the site root), so units without a developer tour now correctly show the built-in walk-inside instead of a "virtual tour" that opened the homepage.

1.72.9

  • Walk-inside works on every apartment: the tour tab now builds a draggable schematic walkthrough from the unit's real data (rooms, size, direction, safe room, balcony) whenever the developer has no 360 tour yet, honestly labeled.
  • View from the window is back, better: a gold button on the view tab flies the live map camera to the apartment's actual floor height, looking out in its real direction, with the view cone on the pin.
  • The apologetic "tour is closed to keep the page fast" copy is gone; inviting one-line copy in all 5 languages.

1.72.8

  • Homepage: new flagship band right under the hero - the four 3D projects with hero plates and 3D badges, in all 5 languages; the differentiator now leads the front door.
  • Hero promo video no longer crops its baked-in text (container matches the video ratio, letterboxed on the dark panel).
  • Upsell tiles restyled as deliberate DNA cards instead of empty dashed slots.
  • Demand-areas grammar: singular forms (one project / one apartment) in all languages.

1.72.7

  • Drone map on the projects catalog: collapsible satellite + 3D-buildings Mapbox band over all geocoded projects, gold pins, click flies in low over the site; honest note that the map grows as locations are verified. Lazy-loaded.
  • Professionals: profession badges now always render Hebrew labels (raw machine enums like urban_planner leaked onto cards); archive meta description added.

1.72.6

  • Big catalog severe upgrade: language siblings (-en/-fr/-ru/-ar) excluded from the grid, facets and counts - no more garbled mixed-language duplicate cards; card titles bidi-isolated so English names ellipsize correctly in RTL; the machine "other" type badge hidden; the sponsored slot card rebuilt without illegal nested anchors (was rendering as a broken empty gold card); the archive finally has a meta description with buyer keywords.

1.72.5

  • Guide schema module: cornerstone guide posts get FAQPage JSON-LD (AEO/AI answer surfaces) printed in wp_head, reciprocal hreflang between HE/EN siblings, and correct html lang on English guides. Reusable via post meta for every future guide.

1.72.4

  • The RFP document is real: every buy-flow request generates a branded, printable, tokenized document (server-side facts only) with the unit, the configuration, matched advisors from the professionals directory, a status timeline and full disclaimers. Linked from the done screen, stored on the lead for the owner.

1.72.3

  • Buy-flow v1 on every apartment panel: "build me an offer" - finish level, advisor and designer add-ons (never pre-checked), 2-field WhatsApp-first capture with consent, honest staged dispatch animation and a what-happens-next timeline. Posts structured RFP context into the lead system. Full 5-language support.

1.72.2

  • The article weaver: same words, magazine packaging - chapter frames with numbered heads and asset thumbs, jump TOC pills, localized labels (he/en/fr/ru/ar). Nothing removed, SEO hierarchy untouched.
  • Default interior: units without their own interior show the project generic interior with an honest label in the page language.
  • wptexturize disabled: WordPress was converting hyphens to en/em dashes at render, re-violating the no-long-dashes law on clean content.

1.72.1

  • View cone on the map: selecting an apartment draws a terracotta cone on the building pin pointing where that apartment looks, rotating with the terrain.
  • Hero/poster split: the marketing hero (project_3d_image) carries the page hero and the premium-catalog card; the 3D model render stays the loading poster so the crossfade remains seamless.
  • Premium catalog cards carry a small 3D badge thumb of the model.

1.72.0

  • ONE map doctrine: the unified POI map (prices, education, transit, shopping, health, future plans, 3D, satellite) now sits directly under the 3D theater; the engine adopts it after render and retires its own plain map (the old DOMContentLoaded move raced the engine and left two maps live).
  • Model-to-map sync: orbiting the 3D building turns the map bearing to match (user gestures only), and selecting an apartment turns the map to face the apartment view direction.
  • Map section fully localized (he/en/fr/ru/ar) - no Hebrew chips on foreign pages.
  • Hebrew compass names in unit meta now map to per-language labels (dir badge leak fixed).
